scripts.start: concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @brain/api dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && pnpm --filter @brain/dashboard dev"
scripts.start:attention: concurrently -n api,dashboard,seed -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @brain/api dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && pnpm --filter @brain/dashboard dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && node scripts/seed-attention.mjs"
scripts.setup:gaze: cd nodes/gaze/server && python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m app.setup_models
scripts.dev:gaze: pnpm --filter @brain/sdk build && pnpm --filter @brain/core build && pnpm --filter @brain/node-gaze build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-signal SIGTERM -n api,dashboard,gaze-tsc,seed -c blue,magenta,yellow,green "pnpm --filter @brain/api dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && pnpm --filter @brain/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @brain/node-gaze dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && node scripts/seed-gaze.mjs"
scripts.setup:voice: cd nodes/voice/server && python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m app.setup_models
scripts.dev:voice: pnpm --filter @brain/sdk build && pnpm --filter @brain/core build && pnpm --filter @brain/node-voice build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-signal SIGTERM -n api,dashboard,voice-tsc,seed -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @brain/api dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && pnpm --filter @brain/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @brain/node-voice dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && node scripts/seed-voice.mjs"
scripts.dev:intent: pnpm --filter @brain/sdk build && pnpm --filter @brain/core build && pnpm --filter @brain/node-voice build && pnpm --filter @brain/node-gaze build && pnpm --filter @brain/node-intent build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-signal SIGTERM -n api,dashboard,voice-tsc,gaze-tsc,intent-tsc,seed -c blue,magenta,cyan,yellow,pink,green "pnpm --filter @brain/api dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && pnpm --filter @brain/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @brain/node-voice dev" "pnpm --filter @brain/node-gaze dev" "pnpm --filter @brain/node-intent dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/network -t 30000 && node scripts/seed-intent.mjs"
